what: New duplicate-code tests need Pylint, but python-tests installs only requirements-test.txt
scenario_or_breakage: The python-tests job runs make py-test without pylint installed, so test_duplicate_code or the cli registry import can fail before the feature is verified
suggested_fix: Add pylint==4.0.5 to python/requirements-test.txt, or otherwise ensure these tests run only where the pinned Pylint dependency is installed

what: Threshold behavior is stricter than current Pylint R0801
scenario_or_breakage: Pylint 4.0.5 reports only blocks with effective common lines greater than min-similarity-lines, so failing at exactly the threshold is not equivalent and can create new CI failures
suggested_fix: Match Pylint semantics in code and tests: at threshold passes, threshold plus one fails, unless the plan explicitly lowers the configured threshold

what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Plan allows copying Pylint's GPL pair-comparison loop into this MIT repo
scenario_or_breakage: The feature can be implemented by calling the pinned internal API, while vendoring GPL code adds avoidable licensing risk and complexity
suggested_fix: Remove the copy fallback; call pylint.checkers.symilar helpers directly and fail closed with exit 2 on API drift
